options.name: a10_device_context_id
options.description: Device ID for aVCS configuration

options.name: a10_partition
options.description: Destination/target partition for object/command

options.name: ack_aggressiveness
options.description: 'low'= Delayed ACK; 'medium'= Delayed ACK, with ACK on each packet with PUSH flag; 'high'= ACK on each packet;

options.name: alive_if_active
options.description: keep connection alive if active traffic

options.name: ansible_host
options.description: Host for AXAPI authentication

options.name: ansible_password
options.description: Password for AXAPI authentication

options.name: ansible_port
options.description: Port for AXAPI authentication

options.name: ansible_username
options.description: Username for AXAPI authentication

options.name: backend_wscale
options.description: The TCP window scale used for the server side, default is off (number)

options.name: del_session_on_server_down
options.description: Delete session if the server/port goes down (either disabled/hm down)

options.name: disable
options.description: send reset to client when server is disabled

options.name: disable_abc
options.description: Appropriate Byte Counting RFC 3465 Disabled, default is enabled (Appropriate Byte Counting (ABC) is enabled by default)

options.name: disable_sack
options.description: disable Selective Ack Option

options.name: disable_tcp_timestamps
options.description: disable TCP Timestamps Option

options.name: disable_window_scale
options.description: disable TCP Window-Scale Option

options.name: down
options.description: send reset to client when server is down

options.name: dynamic_buffer_allocation
options.description: Optimally adjust the transmit and receive buffer sizes of TCP proxy while keeping their sum constant

options.name: early_retransmit
options.description: Configure the Early-Retransmit Algorithm (RFC 5827) (Early-Retransmit is disabled by default)

options.name: fin_timeout
options.description: FIN timeout (sec), default is disabled (number)

options.name: force_delete_timeout
options.description: The maximum time that a session can stay in the system before being deleted, default is off (number (second))

options.name: force_delete_timeout_100ms
options.description: The maximum time that a session can stay in the system before being deleted, default is off (number in 100ms)

options.name: half_close_idle_timeout
options.description: TCP Half Close Idle Timeout (sec), default is off (cmd is deprecated, use fin- timeout instead) (number)

options.name: half_open_idle_timeout
options.description: TCP Half Open Idle Timeout (sec), default is off (number)

options.name: idle_timeout
options.description: Idle Timeout (Interval of 60 seconds), default is 600 (idle timeout in second, default 600)

options.name: init_cwnd
options.description: The initial congestion control window size (packets), default is 10 (init-cwnd in packets, default 10)

options.name: initial_window_size
options.description: Set the initial window size, default is off (number)

options.name: insert_client_ip
options.description: Insert client ip into TCP option

options.name: invalid_rate_limit
options.description: Invalid Packet Response Rate Limit (ms), default is 500 (number default 500 challenges)

options.name: keepalive_interval
options.description: Interval between keepalive probes (sec), default is off (number (seconds))

options.name: keepalive_probes
options.description: Number of keepalive probes sent, default is off

options.name: limited_slowstart
options.description: RFC 3742 Limited Slow-Start for TCP with Large Congestion Windows (number)

options.name: maxburst
options.description: The max packet count sent per transmission event (number)

options.name: min_rto
options.description: The minmum retransmission timeout, default is 200ms (number)

options.name: mss
options.description: Responding MSS to use if client MSS is large, default is off (number)

options.name: nagle
options.description: Enable Nagle Algorithm

options.name: name
options.description: TCP Proxy Template Name

options.name: proxy_header
options.description: Field proxy_header

options.name: psh_flag_optimization
options.description: Enable Optimized PSH Flag Use

options.name: qos
options.description: QOS level (number)

options.name: reassembly_limit
options.description: The reassembly queuing limit, default is 25 segments (number)

options.name: reassembly_timeout
options.description: The reassembly timeout, default is 30sec (number)

options.name: receive_buffer
options.description: TCP Receive Buffer (default 200k) (number default 200000 bytes)

options.name: reno
options.description: Enable Reno Congestion Control Algorithm

options.name: reset_fwd
options.description: send reset to server if error happens

options.name: reset_rev
options.description: send reset to client if error happens

options.name: retransmit_retries
options.description: Number of Retries for Retransmit, default is 5

options.name: server_down_action
options.description: 'FIN'= FIN Connection; 'RST'= Reset Connection;

options.name: state
options.description: State of the object to be created.

options.name: syn_retries
options.description: SYN Retry Numbers, default is 5

options.name: timewait
options.description: Timewait Threshold (sec), default 5 (number)

options.name: transmit_buffer
options.description: TCP Transmit Buffer (default 200k) (number default 200000 bytes)

options.name: user_tag
options.description: Customized tag

options.name: uuid
options.description: uuid of the object
